clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once dated a woman who warned him her mother was impossible - irritating, impossible to be around.

He went anyway. He and her mother hit it off instantly: jokes, real conversation, a great night. His girlfriend sat there stunned, convinced the dinner had been a disaster.

Same mother, same room, same words. Two people, two completely different nights.

The mother never changed. What changed was who was doing the looking.

Who in your life might not be the problem you think they are?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfimprovement #relationships #perspective #growthmindset

Every scripture you can name - the Bible, the Koran, the Vedas - says the same thing: whatever you give out first comes back multiplied.

Kevin Trudeau explains it with a seed. Plant one tomato seed and you don't get one back - you get a plant that produces hundreds.

That's why people who build wealth give first: attention, support, even money, instead of waiting to receive it.

If you want money, give money first. If you want love, give love first.

What are you holding back that you should be giving away?
